response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web developer, but the profile fundamentally mismatches this embedded networking security role. He lacks the required native-level Japanese, has minimal C experience (one brief C/C++ stint in 2014-2015), and shows no evidence of Linux kernel investigation/modification, network switch development, or security technologies like MACsec or 802.1X. His career trajectory centers on web platforms (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), not embedded firmware.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) across varied stacks
Some systems-level exposure: low-latency DLang services, Linux, C/C++ IDE components at National Instruments
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD) and open-source contributions
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed — a hard requirement (native level)
No embedded firmware, Linux kernel, or L2/L3 networking/switch development experience
No demonstrated security-domain expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption, tamper detection)

key_factors.factor: Broad senior engineering experience with some C/Linux exposure
